summary: Compile locked intent into exact production packages and run bounded game or portable-profile candidate work with independent evidence and no automatic installation.
notes: v0.1 executes inert fixtures plus one trusted in-process deterministic documentation Hand. Graceful interruption appends a sealed checkpoint bound to the exact step-ledger count, tail, verified receipt prefix, and prior checkpoint. An opt-in external cache reuses only executors declaring deterministic-v1, verifies immutable entry bytes, and reruns the current appointed verifier on every hit. Every cache-enabled run records a bounded append-only lease before cache use, protects each exact key before reuse or publication, and releases after terminal or checkpoint evidence exists. Lease owner bindings are path-private digests, not authentication. There is no daemon: a crash lease expires unless the same run resumes it. Explicit digest-approved curation can move only released or sufficiently old expired hot segments into lossless compressed cold archives while keeping a sealed recovery anchor. A separate exact-approved rollup may replace multiple inactive cold containers only when its deterministic target is measured smaller; it preserves the complete concatenated event bytes, every original archive receipt, and prior rollup receipts in a sealed lineage. Normal discovery checks the hot anchor and current head shape; only the separate bounded audit rehashes and decompresses the event and lineage blobs. An explicit tier-export proposal can duplicate one inactive fully archived history into a content-addressed package under a separate user-selected root; it never deletes source history. Package audit detects mutation, and exact package approval can restore only into a fresh cache before proving the same deep archive summary in the target. A local folder is not claimed to be immutable or external durability. Rollup and tiering are never automatic and never grant semantic-retention authority. Retention freshly rescans leases and references and coordinates each approved deletion with runner protection under the same key lock. Scheduling and automatic deletion do not exist. Native Godot production remains separately gated and unclaimed.
